compiled_state.title: ticket-scratch store dot-claude-scratch not gitignored -> surfaces as untracked sprint drift (investigate tickets-branch placement)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **Plugin/Tool Versions:** dso-dev 1.17.102
* **Context Scope:** ticket-scratch CLI (ticket-scratch.sh) writing to the .claude scratch path; host-project gitignore
* **code_version:** 9009aabf025fc3ae591a43c55d12007f0435f5bc

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The ticket-scratch store is an ephemeral handoff buffer (sub-agents write JSON payloads there; the orchestrator reads them back). Its on-disk location (the per-ticket scratch path under the .claude dir) should NOT appear as untracked working-tree drift during a sprint, and should not risk being swept into a commit. Either the path should be gitignored by the plugin default, or the scratch store should live outside the working tree entirely.

#### Actual Behavior

The .claude scratch directory is NOT in gitignore. During the waxen-sigma sprint, the planning sub-agents (story-decomposer / approach-proposer / task-decomposer remediation cycles) wrote scratch payloads under the per-ticket scratch path, which then surfaced as an untracked directory in git status. This contributed to a GIT_CLEAN=false precondition at the first sprint batch, and risks the scratch payloads being staged by a git add -A if not explicitly excluded.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:** Observed the untracked scratch dir in git status --short after the implementation-plan planning phase wrote remediation-cycle scratch.
* **Known Workarounds:** Manually appended the scratch path to gitignore mid-sprint (committed in this session) to clean the tree before batch dispatch.

### 7. Additional Details

* Fix: add the .claude scratch path to the plugin-shipped default gitignore (and/or the onboarding-generated gitignore).
* **Investigation note (per user):** evaluate whether the scratch directory should instead be created/managed in the tickets orphan branch (the event-store tree) rather than the working tree — the scratch store is ticket-scoped ephemeral state, conceptually closer to ticket data than to source. Placing it under the tickets orphan branch (or a tmp / non-tracked location like the TMPDIR) would keep it entirely out of the working-tree git status and remove the gitignore dependency. Decide between: (a) gitignore in working tree (simplest), (b) move to TMPDIR / non-tracked, (c) manage under the tickets orphan branch.
* Blast radius: every DSO session that uses ticket-scratch (preplanning story-decomposition, implementation-plan remediation cycles, sprint Step 18 cycle recorder) leaves untracked drift in the .claude scratch dir.
